chunks.title: Book samples
chunks.heading: Book samples without a quotation
chunks.text: Open Samples and choose Book samples. Pick the customer, fill in Reason for no quotation, add each sample with its description and tests, then choose Book job. The job number appears at the top of the job page.

chunks.title: Book samples
chunks.heading: Photos of samples
chunks.text: Add photos of each sample as received with Add photos or Use camera. Photos are optional and can go on the acknowledgement letter.

chunks.title: Invoices and payments
chunks.heading: Record a payment
chunks.text: Open the invoice and choose Record payment. Enter the amount, the payment mode and the reference, then save. The invoice shows Partially paid or Paid.

chunks.title: Reports
chunks.heading: Issue a report
chunks.text: An approved report is issued by the Authorised Signatory. Open the report and choose Issue. Optionally enter Email to so the PDF is emailed to the customer.

chunks.title: Users and roles
chunks.heading: Add a user
chunks.text: Go to Admin, Users and choose Add user. Enter the name, email and a temporary password, tick the roles, then save.

chunks.title: WhatsApp
chunks.heading: Connect WhatsApp
chunks.text: Set WHATSAPP_TOKEN and WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID in the server settings, then send a test message from Admin, WhatsApp.

chunks.title: Runbook for lab IT
chunks.heading: Rotate storage credentials
chunks.text: To rotate the zebracorn storage credentials, update S3_ACCESS_KEY and S3_SECRET_KEY in secrets.env and redeploy.

chunks.title: Quick start
chunks.heading: Quick start
chunks.text: Sign in with your email and password. The dashboard shows My work. Use the search box to find any job, sample, report or invoice.
